opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under 18s

amount.raw: Maximum total award of £475,000 per institution

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions or registered charities delivering outstanding teaching; institutions only, not individuals.
opportunities.summary: Supports arts training for school‑age children under 18 across fine and performing arts, funding up to £475,000 for three‑year awards.

opportunities.title: Art Scholarship Under/Postgraduate

amount.raw: Maximum total award of £475,000 per institution; bursaries £5,000‑£10,000 per student per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Specialist arts training institutions (not university departments) that can demonstrate outstanding teaching; institutions only.
opportunities.summary: Provides bursaries for outstanding undergraduate/postgraduate arts students in need, with up to £475,000 total funding per institution.

opportunities.title: Early Career Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary contribution up to £56,000 in year 1 and £28,000 in years 2‑3; research expenses up to £6,000 per annum

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers who have not yet held a full‑time permanent academic post in the UK; must hold a doctorate and have submitted thesis by the deadline.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships enabling early‑career researchers to undertake a significant piece of publishable research, with full salary contribution in year 1 and 50 % thereafter.

opportunities.title: Emeritus Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Retired senior researchers who have lived in the UK ≥26 weeks/year and held a UK university teaching/research post at retirement.
opportunities.summary: Supports retired scholars to complete or integrate a research project; fellowships 3‑24 months, up to £24,000.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Doctoral Scholarships

amount.raw: Ten awards of up to £5 million each; individual scholarships up to £10,000 per student per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (research degree awarding powers) may apply; consortiums of up to two universities allowed.
opportunities.summary: Centenary doctoral scholarships supporting up to 30 doctoral places (plus master‑plus‑PhD routes) and limited post‑doctoral opportunities, over a 9‑year programme.

opportunities.title: Leverhulme Research Centres

amount.raw: Up to £10 million for up to 10 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (research degree awarding powers) may apply; collaborative centres encouraged; Oxford, Cambridge, Imperial now eligible.
opportunities.summary: Supports establishment of large‑scale, interdisciplinary research centres aiming for a step‑change in scholarship.

opportunities.title: Major Research Fellowships

amount.raw: Salary contribution (starting at junior lecturer scale) plus up to £6,000 per year for research expenses

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established researchers in humanities or social sciences employed at a UK university; cannot have previously held a Major Research Fellowship.
opportunities.summary: Two‑ or three‑year fellowships enabling distinguished scholars to complete a piece of original research.

opportunities.title: Philip Leverhulme Prizes
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers with a permanent UK university post (or long‑term fellowship) who earned their doctorate ≤10 years before the deadline.
opportunities.summary: Annual prizes recognising internationally impactful early‑career researchers; funds may be used for any research‑related purpose.

opportunities.title: Research Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Experienced researchers employed at a UK university (research degree awarding powers); must be resident in the UK and have been impacted by teaching/administrative duties.
opportunities.summary: Three‑ to 24‑month fellowships supporting replacement costs and research expenses for researchers to complete a project.

opportunities.title: Research Leadership Awards

amount.raw: Up to £1 million for staff salaries and associated costs

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career academics with a permanent UK university appointment (lecturer level or equivalent) who have ≤2 years post‑PhD experience and have not yet led a research team.
opportunities.summary: Supports talented early‑career scholars to build and lead a modest research team, developing research leadership over 4‑5 years.

opportunities.title: Research Project Grants – Detailed Applications

amount.raw: Maximum grant value £500,000; up to five‑year duration

opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK universities (and eligible UK research institutes) may apply; principal investigator must be employed by the institution.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative original research projects, covering staff costs, consumables, and associated research expenses.

opportunities.title: Visiting Professorships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK university staff (or specialist arts institutions) coordinating the visit; visitor must be an eminent senior professor from overseas.
opportunities.summary: Supports UK institutions to invite overseas senior professors for 3‑12 month visits, enhancing skills and knowledge in under‑represented research areas.
